// diagnostic

E2407

`#Rename(...)` needs a string literal.

What

`#Rename(...)` needs a string literal.

Why

The wire key a `#Codable` field maps to is a constant string (D-SERDE5); a number or expression has no place on the wire.

Fix

Pass one quoted string — `#Rename("wire_name")`.
